name: Bolaskitter
description: Feet set apart and the spare cord looped in the off hand, so the thrower can turn and cast from balance.

name: Whirlcast Strike
description: One weight swings in a flat circle above the shoulder and flies free along the line of the target's chest.

name: Stiff Stonehead
description: An underhand throw skims the weights along the ground so the cords catch an advancing runner at the ankles.

name: Open Cordfork
description: The held stone ball is swung short on its cord to rap an opponent's knuckles or forearm at close quarters.

name: Wrapup Husk
description: Planted feet and a steady backward haul keep the wrapped cord taut so a tangled opponent cannot run.

name: Swaying Fetter
description: The thrower steps forward and scoops a dropped stone ball up by its cord, ready to whirl again.

name: Watching Ballsling
description: The thrower lets the weights hang from one fist and reads the cord's length against the target's distance before casting.

name: Wide Hobble
description: A short pendulum swing of the weight from the wrist cracks into the shin of an opponent within arm's reach.

name: Fetterlid
description: A flick of the free cord end snaps across the opponent's hand and spoils a grip on a weapon or rope.

name: Ready Heavyball
description: Cord wound twice about the forearm lets the thrower raise the wrapped arm as a guard against a blow.

name: Light Shackle
description: A backward step with an arm haul brings the cast cord skidding back along the ground toward the thrower's feet.

name: Fetterstrike
description: The thrower leads a sprinting target by one stride and casts low so the cords meet the legs mid-stride.

name: Downward Bolaweight
description: A flat sidearm throw sends the weights spinning at knee height across a broad arc in front of the thrower.

name: Pulling Cordthree
description: Both hands haul the cord tight around a snared ankle and hold it pinned to the ground.

name: Folded Tripcord
description: The thrower flicks the hanging weights up to knock aside a low thrown stone or a grasping hand.

name: Shifting Tripcord
description: Two short quick strides close the gap to a stumbling target before it can rise and run again.

name: Bolapause
description: A knee set on the tangled opponent's back keeps the legs bound while the cord is pulled taut and tied.

name: Stopping Bindfall
description: A scuffing step and a false shoulder turn draw the opponent's eyes before the true cast follows low.

name: Stiff Knotcenter
description: The thrower keeps the weights circling overhead at a steady pace, ready to loose them at the chosen mark.

name: Stiff Joinknot
description: A sharp snap of the wrist at the last instant flings the whirling stones in a straight hard line.

name: Raised Spindle
description: Weights spun fast before the chest form a whirring screen that turns away thrown stones and small blades.

name: Bolawedge
description: A sudden reversal of the whirl's direction snaps a cord across an opponent's reaching arm and spoils the grab.

name: Stonehead Review
description: The thrower listens to the pitch of the humming weights to judge their speed and the moment to release.

name: Wrapuppace
description: A lateral step takes the thrower out of a charging line while the weights are loosed from the hip.

name: Orbdash
description: The two cords cross in flight so they bind both legs together at the shins instead of only one.

name: Fetterwedge
description: One weight wraps a single leg and the thrower hauls the cord to pull that foot out from under the target.

name: Orbcowl
description: Hands over hands, the thrower hauls in the cord so the snared target keeps stumbling toward the ground.

name: Blunt Bindfall
description: A lunge with the taut cord laid across the opponent's calves delivers a stinging slap that breaks their stride.

name: Heavyball Count
description: The thrower watches the target's gait to find the instant both feet are apart and the cast will wrap cleanly.

name: Hard Knotcenter
description: All three weights are thrown at once from a spread grip so the cords fan out across the target's legs.

name: Cordfork Wedge
description: The thrower keeps the heavy central ball in hand as an anchor while the two outer cords stay wrapped on the legs.

name: Orbbump
description: A breath of circulating qi firms the wrist so the three cords loop evenly through the throw.

name: Lowered Bolaweight
description: Three cords swung in overlapping circles before the body brush aside thrown stones and flicked blades.

name: Nimble Shackle
description: A step against the direction of the whirl keeps the thrower balanced as the weights come around.

name: Fouling Wrapup
description: The trailing third weight snags a lifted weapon arm and drags it off its line mid-swing.

name: Short Joinknot
description: The three weights, swung short, land together on the opponent's lead knee in one jarring blow.

name: Bolablow
description: The catcher casts so the cord stretches across the fleeing target's path at shin height.

name: Open Whirlcast
description: The catcher throws at a run, matching the quarry's pace so the weights reach its legs before it can turn.

name: Wrapupstrike
description: From the saddle the thrower whirls the weights alongside the mount's flank and looses them toward a runner.

name: Towing Ballsling
description: Steady pulls take the slack out of the snared cord until the quarry's legs are drawn together.

name: Deep Cordfork
description: A quick look at the quarry's hips and shoulders tells the catcher which way it will bolt next.

name: Folded Cordthree
description: The loose cord end snaps out to bat aside a thrown stone or a grasping hand.

name: Narrow Hobble
description: A long low throw wraps the weights around the forelegs of running stock before it can reach the herd.

name: Tripping Fetter
description: The cord loops the hind legs of a bolting beast and draws them together until the animal sinks down.

name: Pushing Spindle
description: A gloved hand bears down on the paying-out cord to slow a snared runner without burning the palm.

name: Stepping Ballsling
description: A sidestep at the last instant lets the thrower slip past a panicked animal that is charging the cord.

name: Warm Cordthree
description: The thrower listens to the quarry's laboured breathing to judge whether it will turn, stand or run.

name: Narrow Stonehead
description: The weights rise into an overhead circle on a slow indrawn breath, gathering speed for the throw.

name: Bolaweight Hit
description: The thrower breathes out sharply and looses the whirling weights together at the target's knees.

name: Fetterpause
description: With breath held, the thrower braces the whole body and keeps the cord at a hard even tension.

name: Heavyball Trot
description: Steps fall in time with the thrower's pulse so the body stays balanced through repeated throws.

name: Bolagauge
description: The thrower marks the instant an opponent draws breath and casts while that opponent is slowest to dodge.

name: Stonewedge
description: One quick snapped whirl of a single weight on a short breath turns aside a stabbing point.

name: Sharp Whirlcast
description: The hips turn first and carry the shoulder and arm, so the weights leave the hand with more speed.

name: Wrapupdrop
description: The thrower turns a whole circle on the ball of one foot and looses the weights at the end of it.

name: Hobbledrop
description: A high lobbed release sends the weights in a long arc to drop onto a distant runner's legs.

name: Nimble Hobble
description: A pivoting step into the spin carries the thrower from standing guard to a full-reach throw.

name: Orbwedge
description: The thrower turns on the spot to wind the snared cord around the target's legs and haul them tighter.

name: Lowered Joinknot
description: A turn against the attack's direction lets the whirling weights brush a swung blow wide of the body.

name: Locking Wrapup
description: A full spin with the weights trailing hides the true line of the cast until the cords are already in flight.
